headline: The US Justice Department has been told to call artificial intelligence 'super intelligence' in line with President Trump's rebranding.
score_reason: New but a wording instruction with limited effect on people.
importance_line: It shows a presidential naming order reaching federal lawyers, but the account rests on unnamed people.
summary: NBC News reports, citing four people familiar with the matter, that a top Trump administration official told the Justice Department to adopt President Trump's rebranding of AI as "super intelligence" or "SI"; Reuters and Bloomberg Law headlines of the same day say the same. This follows an order that MediaNama says Trump signed on 29 Sep 2026 telling agencies to use "superintelligence" in official communications.
notes: Pool source Reuters blocked (401); Reuters did report it. Only NBC's lead was read.
